svg.text: Every path installs an MDM enrollment profile; Intune then reaches the Mac only through Apple Push, so the APNs certificate is the single point of failure.

svg.text: Network: Macs reach *.push.apple.com on TCP 443/5223 and *.manage.microsoft.com, with no TLS inspection.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not Microsoft artwork.
